params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of events returned.

params.name: pagination_key
params.description: Cursor used to fetch the next page of results.

params.name: bot
params.description: Filter by bot detection result (good, bad, all, none).

params.name: ip_address
params.description: Filter events by IP address or CIDR range.

params.name: start
params.description: Filter events created after this Unix epoch time (ms).

params.name: end
params.description: Filter events created before this Unix epoch time (ms).

params.name: reverse
params.description: Sort events from oldest to newest.

params.name: vpn
params.description: Filter events where a VPN was detected.

params.name: virtual_machine
params.description: Filter events where a virtual machine was detected.

params.name: tampering
params.description: Filter events where request tampering was detected.

params.name: incognito
params.description: Filter events where incognito/private browsing was detected.

items.docs: Search identification events for your workspace using a wide range of built-in filters, including visitorId, linkedId, bot, IP address, time range, suspect, and individual Smart Signal flags. Results are paginated with a cursor.
